patch_description: Shift the injury response toward the only non-clone operator with observed evidence and realized benefit: conservative parametric mutation. The current program opens a standard-mutation window despite zero standard evidence/usage, which improves sham slightly but worsens shock. This edit keeps stable-world mutation suppressed, strengthens conservative credit under observed decline/death/intake stress, and trims unproven standard injury probing so post-injury adaptation follows accumulated operator success/evidence instead of speculative exploration.
